messages:
marc_release: Quick sync — canary at 5% in eu-west is showing p95 ~+120ms vs baseline. I'm leaning to HOLD at 5% and patch release notes to call out the perf delta. Thoughts? /deploy status?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for v0.12.3-canary-20260321 (5% eu-west) — metrics endpoint: http://dash/canary/8612345670 — p50: 85ms p95: 320ms (baseline p95: 200ms)
alice_ops: link to graphs please? need the tail over last 10m. :eyes:
tj_prod: if eu-west is the hotspot we can pin traffic there back to v0.12.2 for region-only rollback. Otherwise do a hold and investigate. pining is quick but is last-resort.
sre_kim: any OOMs, evictions, or CPU steal on those pods? paste the kube events or flamegraphs if you have them.
marc_release: no OOMs in the quick check, CPU healthy. I grabbed a sample trace — looks like attention kernel stalls on long requests. putting snippet: ```TRACE: model_infer (1200ms) -> softmax (480ms) -> attention_kern (700ms)```
sam_platform: Suggestion: instead of an immediate rollback, reduce canary to 2% and enable latency-based routing to favor nodes with lower tail. That buys time for SRE to dig in and gives us more signal without blowing up client latency.
marc_release: Good call. Also want to update release notes to mention "known p95 regression in specific prompt lengths" and mitigation steps. I'll open a small edits PR — who can approve quick?
alice_ops: I can approve the notes PR. Also :thumbsup: on reducing to 2%.
tj_prod: Vote: STOP (hold). Pin option if diagnosics show infra-level regression. Also consider temporary batch_size=1 override for the canary pods to test if batching is the culprit.
deploy-bot: Traffic adjusted: canary reduced from 5% -> 2% in eu-west at 8612345685 by operator marc_release.
sre_kim: I'll collect flamegraphs + kube events and post in ~8-10m. If we don't see mem pressure or kernel-level queuing, we can try the small batch_size patch in a fresh canary.
marc_release: Consensus: HOLD and investigate. I'll open release-note PR #452 with the language and rollback plan. tagging @alice_ops and @tj_prod for quick review. Will update thread with flamegraphs and decision after SRE analysis. :white_check_mark:
